function.name: subagent
function.description: Fire a ONE-SHOT chat completion in its own LM Studio slot — no tools, no parent history. Use it for summaries, translations, classifications, or any task you can express as a single prompt/response. The child shares the loaded model pool, so keep max_tokens modest (default capped by settings). Pass background=true for tasks you do not need to wait on; the result arrives later as a message tagged [inbox from task].

prompt.description: The user-role message for the child completion

system.description: Optional system prompt for the child completion

max_tokens.description: Response budget for the child (default: subagent_max_tokens setting, typically 20000)

model.description: Model id to use for the child; omit to use the parent's current model

background.description: true = do not wait: returns at once with a task id while the completion runs. Its output arrives later as a message tagged [inbox from task], and the full output is at output/tasks/<id>.log (read it with the read tool).
